mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases across the market.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase exceeding 4.5% in a 3-month window signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 1150.0 and 470000.0 respectively indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1150.0 and RSAFS < 470000.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% in one month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 in a one-month window indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as supply chain disruptions impact earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 104.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200.0 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.1% in one month signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% in one month indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
